profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Product Owner | Team Lead at SAP
profile.summary:
I am a Senior Software Engineer with extensive proven experience in the corporate software development industry and advanced programming, design, architecture, and analysis skills. I am and enthusiastic and professional team member and leader with a commitment to life-long learning and innovation. Always curious. Strong background in mathematics. 

Specialties: Mobile Development; Automated Testing; Object Oriented Design, Architecture and Patterns; Agile/Iterative and Traditional development life cycle models. 

Technologies: Swift and Objective-C (iOS); JavaScript; TypeScript; NativeScript; node and npm; Java (Android); Git; C++; Bash; Python.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Product Owner
positions.description:
Mobile Development Kit (MDK)

Created a NativeScript prototype which became the next generation metadata-based application development platform for SAP known as the Mobile Development Kit. MDK is a platform that allows business experts to create mobile applications with advanced enterprise features such as offline support and authentication. These applications are capable of running on Android and iOS devices with minimal maintenance costs. MDK is currently maintained by several teams across the world and the product is used for several production applications.

Architected and designed numerous MDK Client features. Native iOS and Android design and development. Typescript and Javascript design and development with NativeScript. Strive for maximum automated unit test coverage. Integration with multiple complex native SDKs. 

Designed and implemented numerous JavaScript (Web-based) MDK Editor features (Code-less Toolkit running on SAP's WebIDE).

Worked as Scrum Team Product Owner for MDK. Interacting with stakeholders in order to gather requirements, translate them into technical work items for the team, and research and implement proof-of-concepts of desired features.

Working remotely since 2013.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / iOS Platform Team Lead
positions.description:
Team Lead charged with the design, development, and maintenance of the Agentry iOS client. 

Led the redesign of the iOS client to adopt the new features of iOS 7 and support its new APIs.

Implemented and designed the OpenUI feature (patent) that allows the client's UI to be extended by users in order to reduce development costs.

(SAP acquired Syclo in 2012)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / iOS Platform Team Lead
positions.description:
Led the team of developers tasked with the design, development, and maintenance of the Agentry iOS client. Agentry is a software platform for designing, deploying and managing the entire lifecycle of mobile projects.

Maintained Apple's development program credentials and entitlements. Maintained and updated the continuous integration and automated testing systems (BuildBot).

Worked on the development of the Agentry mobile enterprise application platform's client, server and app editor components. Clients ran on Windows desktop and all Windows Mobile as well as iOS and Android systems. Server components ran on Windows Server and Linux, using SQL Server, Oracle, Java, and file system storage. Editor, ran as an Eclipse plugin.

Maintained existing products across different platforms in a high-pressure environment in order to meet multiple, high-priority requirements from customers and upper management.

Strived for full automated unit test coverage and adoption of latests SDKs and technologies.

Studied development lifecycle processes and participated in Scrum/Agile processes.

(SAP acquired Syclo in 2012)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Virtualization/Hypervisor firmware developer for IBM Power Servers.

Designed and implemented the configuration management component that allows the hypervisor to communicate with the hardware management console in order to partition the server into multiple virtual machines with their own memory, processor, and IO resources.

Designed and implemented a virtual machine performance statistics tracking/reporting system critical for the server's ability to respond to load changes and self re-configure itself on-demand.

Lead and coordinator for several testing strategies for various virtual machine configuration functions.

Received multiple client appreciation awards.

Highly recognized and consistent job performance.

Worked remotely 2009 to 2011.

positions.title: Intern - Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developer for the Power Hypervisor Automated Test Harness speed team.

Designed and implemented an automated test harness to test several configuration features of the IBM Power family of server products as well as blade systems.

Created an optimized randomization engine for the Automated Test Harness for smart randomized testing; and a complete Graphical User Interface using Perl/Tk.

positions.title: Research/Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Developer and researcher in the Systems Research Laboratory (SyLab).

Participated in the research and development of the DiskBench Project funded by the National Science Foundation. DiskBench consisted of empirical collection of data from hard drives in order to determine optimal configuration for usage.

Taught an Operating Systems laboratory at FIU. Class consisted of implementation of important OS concepts in C/C++.

patents.title: Open User Interface
patents.description: In an example embodiment, a definition is loaded into a client application for execution on a user device. Then, one or more classes defined in a central repository database of a server are loaded into the client application. It may then be determined that one or more custom classes not defined in the central repository database are contained in the definition. The one or more custom classes may be validated by ensuring that they contain one or more preset functions. The one or more custom classes may then be loaded into the client application, thereby overriding or extending at least one of the one or more classes defined in the central repository database.

patents.title: Method for distributing hypervisor memory requirements across logical partitions.
patents.description: A method of reallocating memory to a hypervisor in a virtualized computing system, includes: assigning priorities to a plurality of logical partitions configured within the virtualized computing system; determining a memory requirement for the hypervisor, the hypervisor configured to manage the plurality of logical partitions; determining minimum levels of memory required for each of the plurality of logical partitions; determining the amount of available memory in the virtualized computing system; and in the event that the amount of available memory is less than the determined memory requirement of the hypervisor, removing portions of memory from one or more of the plurality of logical partitions based on the assigned priorities until the determined memory requirement for the hypervisor is obtained.
